# Power steering hose routing and types

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] The power steering system uses a high pressure hose and a return line prone to cracking. [t2289]

## Parts

- [Partial] High Pressure Hose: Runs from reservoir to pump/box area. [t2289]
- Return Line: Also known as the suction hose. [t2289]

## Tips & gotchas

- The return line is where air bubbles often enter if leaking. [t2289]
- Hoses get rock hard near the exhaust manifold and crack easily. [t2289]
